purpose: Admit an already-authorized work unit to a provider/harness-neutral runtime modality without conflating host hard limits, workflow envelopes, provider quotas, machine capacity, or authority/capability gates.
non_goals: choose semantic ownership or runtime placement
grant judgment authority or infer model quality
treat one product name as one universal execution capability
proof_ceiling: Synthetic tests prove admission and fallback semantics only. Live provider limits, quota truth, native dispatch, and production behavior require adapter-specific runtime evidence.
